full_details: You looked at the letter in the morning and had a mind to take one word out of it. You left the word. The seal was not broken. In the afternoon the plot was The Shrew, and your side was an old man's, with no name of a part worth copying into a letter. The Verona papers stayed shut. You did not open the death, and you did not open the coffer.
one_sentence: You looked at the word live, and at two you played an old man's side in The Shrew.
title: Looked at the word live and played an old man's side
